headline: U.S. Budget Deficit & High Yields
detail: Swelling deficits and high Treasury yields create headwinds for growth stocks. This increases borrowing costs and pressures valuations across your tech and chip holdings.
rec: Consider trimming positions with "SELL" status, especially those with gains like CRWD, to reduce overall portfolio risk in this environment.

headline: Tech Selloff Hits Software & Chips
detail: This confirms broad weakness across your core sectors. A widespread tech selloff makes it challenging for individual names to recover, impacting your concentrated portfolio.
rec: Review "SELL" status tech/chip holdings like SMCI and SNOW. Ensure stops are respected or consider trimming to manage exposure during this downturn.

headline: Bond Market Shrugs Off Inflation
detail: The bond market's behavior suggests persistent inflation concerns or higher rates. This reinforces macro uncertainty and adds pressure on growth stocks, especially your leveraged positions.
rec: No direct trade action from this headline. Continue to watch macro indicators closely and maintain tight risk management on all leveraged holdings.
